1948, January 22
The following is a faithful transcription of a photocopy of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
Bles'd be God in all and each of His designs! January 22nd 1948
Mrs. Leon Hekenrath -
My Dear Niece: God bless you and all yours! Many thanks for your kind remembrance of a month ago. Only To-day did I come to it though duely received and noted
I've been down most of the time since a week or so before Christmas - eczema or its twin psoriasis.
Thanks be to God, however, I only missed four holy Masses - two on Christmas and two otherwise. Otherwise my health has been good: God be praised. I hope you are all continuing well. How nice that so many of you can have your dear Mother so near.
- I have enrolled you for your hearing especially in the Ser M. As'n as the card indicates. I think it would help if you made a proposition to the Poor Souls - including your relatives specially- that you will enroll them most specilly, say for a small % of the Dr. bill if your hearing improve with out treatment so as to surprise the doctors(Then have as many as possible to offer holy communion often. Fr. Sol.
Praised be Jesus.
Original in possession of: Mrs. Aurelia Herkenrath 1019 108th Ave., N.E. Apt 117 Bellevue, Wash., 98004
